name: Content provenance, safety, or rights report
about: Report a public Agent/Skill package that should be investigated or paused
title: "[Content report] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

**Do not post secrets, private prompts, user conversations, unpublished work, or personal data in a public issue.** If a report needs those details, do not file it publicly; use a listed private contact if one exists. Otherwise, do not send sensitive details.

- Artifact ID and version (or exact source URL):
- Type of concern: rights / attribution / license or NOTICE / unsafe instruction / misleading provenance / other
- Public evidence links and the exact file or line involved:
- Requested action: investigate / pause / correct attribution / remove / other
- Are you the rights holder or their representative? If yes, say so without posting private identity documents.

Maintainers should acknowledge the report, record a traceable decision, pause affected routing or downloads when warranted, preserve prior audit history, and give the contributor a way to respond or submit a corrected version. Filing a report is not a quality rating or an automatic finding of infringement.
